title: phaseolus vulgaris var. lardinus
intro: Phaseolus vulgaris var. lardinus, commonly known as the broad bean, is a type of legume plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family. The health benefits of broad bean include being rich in protein, fiber, and various essential minerals, making it a nutritious addition to a balanced diet. The therapeutic actions of broad bean include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of broad bean include polyphenols, saponins, and isoflavones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
